why: Current baseline practice for Ludhiana, Punjab: Puddled Rice → Wheat → Fallow.
Conventional puddled transplanted rice (PTR) creates continuous water table depletion and narrow turnaround windows.
Post-harvest residue burning depletes topsoil organic matter, microbial biomass, and volatile nitrogen. Narrow 11-day harvest-to-sowing turnaround increases stubble burning pressure.
Baseline water demand averages 1057 mm/yr, with a 10-year SOC balance of -1.87 t C/ha and soil health index of 22/100 [FAO-56, RothC-26.3].
Baseline median net return is ₹174,686/ha, dropping to ₹131,548/ha in severe drought years (CVaR-10).
